summary: The site's copilot (retrieval plus tools that read Arc and PREPARE actions the user signs; it never holds a key) runs in its own Intel TDX VM. The browser verifies the copilot's key against the registry, then encrypts the conversation to the enclave: the web server that relays it sees ciphertext only.

protocol.name: ARC-COPILOT-CHAT-v1
protocol.request: HPKE base mode, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / ChaCha20-Poly1305, info = keccak256(abi.encode(tag, chainId, EnclaveRegistry, productId, enclaveSigner)): a ciphertext prepared for another enclave, product or chain does not open
protocol.response: sealed for that request only, with a key exported from the request's HPKE context (as in Oblivious HTTP, RFC 9458): a relay can neither read, modify nor replay it

modelAttestation.provider: RedPill private AI gateway (Attested Confidential Inference), verified by the enclave with @phala/aci-verifier 0.11.0 (Apache-2.0)
modelAttestation.checks: at start and every 30 min with a fresh nonce: the gateway's Intel TDX quote to Intel's root (dcap-qvl), its workload keyset bound to the quote for our nonce, keys not expired, its docker-compose measured into RTMR3 (event log replayed), and - ArcHive's own check - its OS image is the PRODUCTION dstack image (os-image-hash in RTMR3: 8db40cb23008d6213668b5816702d100b37b859a8a5bfd18d938ae3a1b3715bd)
modelAttestation.channel: every model call goes over TLS pinned to the gateway's attested key (SPKI in the keyset)
modelAttestation.serving: every answer must carry a gateway receipt citing a verified upstream session (requireVerified, requireReceipt)
modelAttestation.failClosed: if the gateway cannot be verified, the enclave does not start

isolation: own VM: a flaw in the copilot cannot produce quotes for the inference or bounty products
tee: Intel TDX confidential VM (dstack) on Phala Cloud
verifiedOnArc: Intel's signature on each TDX quote is checked on-chain by Automata DCAP: TdxAttestationModule 0x26C1803dE523aC896Ba7F1787f1401ec792951ca -> AutomataDcapAttestationFee 0x48640f7d94dE64b13c89686F3d1240A31Aeb4dc9
imageFingerprint: v2.1: the registry replays the dstack RTMR3 event log on-chain (SHA-384), requires it to reproduce the quote's RTMR3, and allows the image by keccak256(MRTD | RTMR0 | RTMR1 | RTMR2 | compose-hash | os-image-hash | XFAM | TDATTRIBUTES) - no instance id, so a restart keeps the same fingerprint
reportData: REPORTDATA[0:32] binds chain id, registry, product id, operator, enclave signer and X25519 key; REPORTDATA[32:64] is a recent block hash (EIP-2935)
